# Library notice for borrowers who already reserved a tool

The library needs a notice for borrowers with an existing tool reservation for pickup at the West Room between 12 and 16 May. During those five days, existing West Room reservations will be collected at the North Desk in the same building. The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies. Bring the confirmation and a library card. Borrowers with a later pickup date should use the location on their confirmation. The change applies to pickups only. Returns remain at the usual return counter.

A few staff suggested keeping the North Desk for the summer. Management has made no decision about summer. In a desk drill, staff located nine of ten test records on the first lookup. These were test records and no borrowers took part. The notice should help people collect their existing reservations during the temporary change.

--- END SOURCE: library-notice.md ---

idea.title: Temporary pickup location for existing West Room reservations
idea.description: Tell borrowers to collect their reserved tools at the North Desk from 12 to 16 May during their original pickup window. Bring the confirmation and library card.
idea.audience: Borrowers with an existing West Room pickup from 12 to 16 May
idea.rationale: The notice helps borrowers collect existing reservations during the temporary change. Returns use the usual counter.
idea.evidence: The notice specifies dates, unchanged pickup windows and required documents.
